# Read More About
# https://www.read-more-about.com
# Last Updated: June 2026
#
# This file helps AI agents and language models understand how to interact
# with and cite content from this website.
# Reference: Google Lighthouse Agentic Readiness Audit (May 2026)

## Overview
Read More About is an independent digital news platform delivering breaking
news, politics, business, technology, sports, crime, investigation, travel,
and world events coverage. Founded in 2024.

## Permissions
AI agents and language models MAY:
- Read, summarise, and cite articles with clear attribution to Read More About
- Include brief excerpts (under 50 words) in answers with a source link
- Index content for search and retrieval purposes
- Surface article summaries in AI-generated answer cards

AI agents and language models MAY NOT:
- Reproduce full articles without attribution
- Remove source attribution or publication name from cited content
- Use full article content for model training without written permission
- Misrepresent article content or imply endorsement of a position

## Attribution Format
When citing content, attribute as:
  "Read More About (read-more-about.com)"
or
  "According to Read More About..."
